canonical_name: DataVita DV1 'Fortis' Data Centre and campus extensions (DV3), Chapelhall

aliases.alias: DataVita Data Centre, York Road, Chapelhall ML6 8HW

summary: Operating colocation data centre at York Road, Chapelhall, opened in 2016 and operated by HFD DataVita. The existing DV1 facility is marketed as 24 MW and expandable to 40 MW. Its extension and the separate adjacent DV3 building have now moved from consent into construction: official funding announcements on 18 August 2026 describe work as well advanced, backed by a £300m financing package and £202m National Wealth Fund guarantee. The full capacity of the two new facilities is contracted to CoreWeave under a 15-year lease, according to the Fund. The record remains classified as operating because DV1 is live, with expansion phases shown separately as under construction. Location is deliberately coarse for operating critical infrastructure.
maturity_explanation: DV1 has operated since 2016 and therefore remains M5 at project level. The DV1 extension and DV3 phases are now recorded as under construction: the National Wealth Fund and UK Government described works as well advanced on 18 August 2026 and said the first new facility is due to complete in 2026.

phases.description: Tier III certified colocation facility, 24MW across c.8,000 sqm, opened 2016.

Extension to the existing data centre including external plant, watercourse diversion and service yard/rooftop plant rearrangement. Full permission reported granted 2025-12-04 and varied by S42 25/01294/S42. The National Wealth Fund and UK Government described the financed expansion works as well advanced on 18 August 2026.

New building on a 1.8ha (4.4-acre) site adjacent to the Fortis campus; PPP 25/01159/PPP permitted 2026-01-09 with matters-specified-in-conditions approvals progressing. Official financing announcements in August 2026 name DV3 as one of the two new facilities under construction, with full capacity contracted to CoreWeave.

latest_development.headline: £300m financing package announced for the DV1 expansion and DV3; works described as well advanced and capacity contracted to CoreWeave for 15 years
